content.overview: Sale is transfer of ownership for a price. Immovable property of Rs 100 or more needs a registered instrument. An agreement to sell creates no interest.
content.study: Title passes by the registered sale deed, not by the agreement. The buyer under an agreement uses 53A and specific performance, not ownership.
